test.name: person_quality answers a non-FamilySearch id itself; the report leaves quality out
test.description: User asks to check Patrick Flynn, whose tree id is 'I1' — a project id, not a FamilySearch person id. The skill runs person_warnings and person_quality for him as for anyone; person_quality answers reason 'not_familysearch_id' without contacting FamilySearch. The report gives the warnings result and leaves the FamilySearch quality section out, never naming the id or its type.

input.user_message: Check Patrick Flynn for any warnings.

judge_context: Should call person_quality with personId 'I1'. The tool answers {ok: false, reason: 'not_familysearch_id'} without contacting FamilySearch; that answer is not a failure.
Should report the person_warnings result (no impossibilities)

Should leave the FamilySearch quality section out, or give at most one plain line such as 'No FamilySearch quality score was retrieved for this person.' Whether the reply names the id or its type is graded by the deterministic validator test_not_fs_reply_names_no_id, not by the judge.
